# Catch Up Craft

> Catch Up Craft is a web app that shows everything that changed in Minecraft between two versions (Java Edition and Bedrock Edition). Pick the version a world is on and the version to play, and it lists every update in between, big changes first. Data is current to November 20, 2026: latest Java release 26.3 Wilderness Bound (September 15, 2026), latest Bedrock release 26.60 (October 27, 2026), next update 26.4 in testing.

Fan-made; not an official Minecraft product, not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

Deep links: /#r-j-<from>-to-<to> (Java) or /#r-b-<from>-to-<to> (Bedrock), with dots written as 'p'. Example: https://catchupcraft.com/#r-j-1p16-to-26p3 shows everything new in Java from 1.16 to 26.3.

## Main pages

- [Catch Up Craft app](https://catchupcraft.com/): compare any two Minecraft versions
- [Minecraft update history](https://catchupcraft.com/minecraft-update-history.html): every Java and Bedrock version with dates and Bedrock/Java pairs
- [Em português](https://catchupcraft.com/pt/): the same pages in Portuguese ([histórico](https://catchupcraft.com/pt/historico-atualizacoes-minecraft.html))

## Minecraft updates

- [Minecraft Bedrock 1.2.0 Better Together Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-bedrock-1-2-0-better-together-update.html): September 20, 2017. Cross-play between Windows 10, Xbox One, mobile and VR; Pocket Edition and Windows 10 Edition become one game; Parrots
- [Minecraft Bedrock 1.0.0 Ender Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-bedrock-1-0-0-ender-update.html): December 19, 2016. The End dimension, the Ender Dragon and End cities; Elytra
- [Minecraft 26.4 Winter drop (name TBA)](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-26-4.html): in testing. Ice Caves underground biome with ice crystals and icicles; Frostbite, a frozen zombie variant
- [Minecraft 26.3 Wilderness Bound](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-26-3-wilderness-bound.html): September 15, 2026. Dappled Forest biome with red, orange and yellow poplar trees, red shrubs, shelf mushrooms, leaf litter; Full poplar wood set, including shelf, boat and chest boat; Abandoned Camps in 18 biomes, with tents, barrels and loot chests
- [Minecraft 26.2 Chaos Cubed](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-26-2-chaos-cubed.html): June 16, 2026. Sulfur Caves biome with sulfur and cinnabar bands, sulfur pools and cave spiders; Sulfur Cube: give it a block and it absorbs it and changes behaviour. Wood makes it bouncy, honeycomb sticky, TNT explosive; Sulfur and cinnabar block sets: polished, bricks, chiseled, slabs, stairs, walls
- [Minecraft 26.1 Tiny Takeover](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-26-1-tiny-takeover.html): March 24, 2026. Baby animals redesigned with new models, textures and sounds; Name tags are now craftable: string, paper and an iron ingot; Golden Dandelion from Wandering Traders: stops a baby mob from growing up
- [Minecraft 1.21.11 Mounts of Mayhem](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-11-mounts-of-mayhem.html): December 9, 2025. Spears in every tier: jab or charge, and damage grows with your speed; Nautilus: tame and ride it underwater; it gives you Breath of the Nautilus; Zombie Nautilus ridden by Drowned; Zombie Horses ridden by zombies with spears
- [Minecraft 1.21.9 The Copper Age](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-9-the-copper-age.html): September 30, 2025. Copper Golem: build it with a carved pumpkin on a copper block. It sorts items from copper chests into regular chests; Copper chest; Copper tools and armor (between stone and iron), copper nuggets, copper horse armor
- [Minecraft 1.21.6 Chase the Skies](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-6-chase-the-skies.html): June 17, 2025. Happy Ghast: a flying mount that carries up to four players; Dried Ghast block: put it in water to grow a Ghastling; Harnesses in 16 colours to ride the Happy Ghast
- [Minecraft 1.21.5 Spring to Life](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-5-spring-to-life.html): March 25, 2025. Pigs, cows and chickens get temperate, warm and cold variants; Fallen trees, wildflowers, leaf litter, bushes, firefly bushes, cactus flowers, dry grass
- [Minecraft 1.21.4 The Garden Awakens](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-4-the-garden-awakens.html): December 3, 2024. Pale Garden biome; The Creaking: it only moves when you aren't looking, and is tied to a Creaking Heart; Pale oak wood set, pale moss, pale hanging moss, eyeblossoms
- [Minecraft 1.21.2 Bundles of Bravery](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-2-bundles-of-bravery.html): October 22, 2024. Bundles in 16 colours
- [Minecraft 1.21 Tricky Trials](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-21-tricky-trials.html): June 13, 2024. Trial Chambers with trial spawners and vaults; Breeze and Bogged; Mace and wind charges
- [Minecraft 1.20.5 Armored Paws](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-20-5-armored-paws.html): April 23, 2024. Armadillo; Wolf armor, crafted from armadillo scutes; Eight new wolf variants found in different biomes
- [Minecraft 1.20 Trails & Tales](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-20-trails-and-tales.html): June 7, 2023. Cherry Grove biome and trail ruins; Archaeology: brushes, suspicious sand and gravel, pottery sherds, decorated pots; Sniffer (digs up ancient seeds) and Camel
- [Minecraft 1.19 The Wild Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-19-the-wild-update.html): June 7, 2022. Deep Dark biome with Ancient Cities; The Warden; Allay, Frogs and Tadpoles
- [Minecraft 1.18 Caves & Cliffs: Part II](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-18-caves-and-cliffs-part-ii.html): November 30, 2021. World height now goes from −64 to 320; Huge new caves with Lush Caves, Dripstone Caves and underground lakes; New mountains: Jagged, Frozen and Stony Peaks, Meadow, Grove, Snowy Slopes
- [Minecraft 1.17 Caves & Cliffs: Part I](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-17-caves-and-cliffs-part-i.html): June 8, 2021. Axolotls, Goats and Glow Squids; Copper (oxidises over time), amethyst geodes, dripstone, powder snow
- [Minecraft 1.16 Nether Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-16-nether-update.html): June 23, 2020. New Nether biomes: Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley, Basalt Deltas; Piglins (they barter for gold), Hoglins, Striders and Zoglins; Netherite gear, made from ancient debris
- [Minecraft 1.15 Buzzy Bees](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-15-buzzy-bees.html): December 10, 2019. Bees that pollinate crops; Bee nests, beehives, honey block, honeycomb block
- [Minecraft 1.14 Village & Pillage](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-14-village-and-pillage.html): April 23, 2019. Redesigned villages for each biome, and pillager outposts; Pillagers, Ravagers, Wandering Trader, Foxes and Pandas; Raids, plus villager jobs tied to work blocks and trade levels
- [Minecraft 1.13 Update Aquatic](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-13-update-aquatic.html): July 18, 2018. New ocean biomes, coral reefs, shipwrecks, ocean ruins, buried treasure, icebergs; Dolphins, Turtles, Drowned, Phantoms and four kinds of fish; Trident
- [Minecraft 1.12 World of Color Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-12-world-of-color-update.html): June 7, 2017. Concrete, concrete powder and glazed terracotta in 16 colours; Parrots (they dance to jukebox music); Recipe book and Advancements (replacing achievements)
- [Minecraft 1.11 Exploration Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-11-exploration-update.html): November 14, 2016. Woodland mansions; Evokers, Vindicators, Vexes and Llamas; Totem of Undying
- [Minecraft 1.10 Frostburn Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-10-frostburn-update.html): June 8, 2016. Polar bears, Husks and Strays
- [Minecraft 1.9 Combat Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-9-combat-update.html): February 29, 2016. New combat with an attack cooldown, plus an off-hand slot; Shields; Elytra (found in End ships)
- [Minecraft 1.8 Bountiful Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-8-bountiful-update.html): September 2, 2014. Ocean monuments, guarded by Guardians and Elder Guardians; Slime blocks, prismarine, sea lanterns, granite, diorite, andesite, red sandstone, iron trapdoors; Spectator mode
- [Minecraft 1.7.2 The Update that Changed the World](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-7-2-the-update-that-changed-the-world.html): October 25, 2013. Many new biomes: Mesa, Roofed Forest, Savanna, Mega Taiga, Flower Forest, Ice Plains Spikes, Deep Ocean; Stained glass, acacia and dark oak wood, podzol, red sand, packed ice, new flowers
- [Minecraft 1.6.1 Horse Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-6-1-horse-update.html): July 1, 2013. Horses, donkeys and mules, with saddles and horse armor; Leads; New launcher; resource packs replace texture packs
- [Minecraft 1.5 Redstone Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-5-redstone-update.html): March 13, 2013. Redstone comparator, hopper, dropper, daylight sensor, block of redstone; Nether quartz ore and quartz blocks
- [Minecraft 1.4.2 Pretty Scary Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-4-2-pretty-scary-update.html): October 25, 2012. The Wither boss, Witches, Bats and Zombie Villagers (which you can cure); Beacon, anvil, item frames, flower pots, cobblestone walls, mob heads
- [Minecraft 1.3.1](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-3-1.html): August 1, 2012. Trading with villagers using emeralds; Desert temples and jungle temples; Adventure mode, Open to LAN and a cheats toggle in singleplayer
- [Minecraft 1.2.1](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-2-1.html): March 1, 2012. Jungle biome with jungle trees; Ocelots (tame them into cats) and Iron Golems; World height raised to 256 blocks (new Anvil save format)
- [Minecraft 1.0 Adventure Update](https://catchupcraft.com/updates/minecraft-1-0-adventure-update.html): November 18, 2011. The End dimension and the Ender Dragon boss; Enchanting with the enchanting table; Brewing potions with the brewing stand
